claim: Elaisa Energetic Wellness day entry costs EUR 65 weekdays / EUR 69 weekend, evening entry from 5 PM is EUR 49/53, with discrete-nude policy except swimwear on Wednesdays, Thursdays, first Saturday and third Sunday of each month; open daily 10:00-22:00.
quote: Weekday (Mon-Fri): EUR 65.00 day entry | EUR 49.00 evening (from 5 PM). Weekend (Sat-Sun): EUR 69.00 day entry | EUR 53.00 evening. Every Wednesday and Thursday, the first Saturday, and third Sunday of each month is swimwear day. Daily 10:00-22:00.

claim: Elaisa Energetic Wellness is located at Terhills in Maasmechelen on the edge of National Park Hoge Kempen and features 11 saunas (including Temazcal, Chakra balancing, ceremonial and infusion saunas) plus 8 baths including outdoor whirlpools and a Kneipp bath.
quote: Unique wellness facilities in Maasmechelen ... eleven saunas including a Temazcal, Chakra balancing saunas, a ceremonial sauna and various infusion saunas, along with eight baths including an energetic bath, a Kneipp bath and two outdoor whirlpools.

claim: Carbon Sense City Spa on the fifth floor of Carbon Hotel Genk is a 700 m2 wellness facility open to non-guests on weekends 10:00-19:00 with a EUR 19 Sense package (towels, slippers, bathrobe), swimwear mandatory; weekday hours Mon-Fri 15:00-22:00, weekend 10:00-22:00.
quote: Carbon Sense City Spa is a 700 m2 facility ... on the fifth floor of the Carbon Hotel ... Non-hotel guests can visit on Saturday and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Swimwear is mandatory! A day pass package costs EUR 19, which includes towels, slippers, and a bathrobe.

claim: Aquadroom Sauna & Wellness in Maaseik offers a full-day arrangement (often discounted via partners) giving unlimited access to all saunas, steam bath and rooftop terrace.
quote: A hamam arrangement for 2 persons is available for EUR 54.99 (regular value EUR 110), which includes a full day of unlimited access to all saunas, wellness facilities, steam bath and roof terrace.

claim: Aquadroom in Maaseik (Sportlaan 10, inside the Lotto Dome complex) operates a Sanarium, Loyly and Kelo sauna, Turkish steam bath, Garra Rufa foot spa, rooftop outdoor pool and ice hut.
quote: Sauna Sanarium, Sauna Loyly, and Sauna Kelo ... Turkish steam bath, foot baths, experience showers ... on the roof deck you can cool off and enjoy the sun in the outdoor pool ... you cool off afterwards in their ice hut.

claim: Aquadroom's adjoining swimming pool charges EUR 9.50 for adults 6-54 in the afternoon (EUR 7 for residents), EUR 5.50 for 55+, with a separately priced wellness/sauna section.
quote: Ages 6-54: EUR 9.50 (EUR 7 for local residents); Ages 55+: EUR 5.50. Entry Fees valid from January 5, 2026.

claim: Domein Kelchterhoef in Houthalen-Helchteren offers heath, ponds and centuries-old trees with a roughly 3 km walking loop around the Plas (lake) and longer marked routes of 2.2 / 3.7 / 6.4 / 9 km starting opposite the Abdijhoeve.
quote: You walk along rustic ponds, centuries-old trees, tree lanes, and extended heath plains. The walk around the Plas is approximately 3 km long ... marked routes in different lengths: 2.2 km, 3.7 km, 6.4 km, and 9 km. All walks start at the information point opposite the Abdijhoeve.

claim: Kajak Maasland in Lanaken/Maasmechelen rents kayaks and canoes for self-guided trips on the Maas to Maaseik, with a 13 km route taking 2.5-5 hours and a 21 km route via Negenoord and Bichterwaard for around EUR 25 per adult; open daily April 1 - October 31, reservation advised.
quote: Kajak Maasland offers kayak, canoe, and raft rentals on the Maas River from Lanaken/Maasmechelen, open daily from April 1st to October 31st ... a 3-person canoe costs EUR 25 per person ... The 13 km route takes 2.5 to 5 hours ... a longer 21 km route ... to near Maaseik.

claim: The Mechelse Heide gateway of National Park Hoge Kempen (Joseph Smeetslaan 280, Maasmechelen) offers free-access heath walks of roughly 3-13 km with sand dunes, pine forest and a panorama point; a recommended red triangle loop is 7.3 km, and heather blooms purple in August-September.
quote: The official access gate is located at Joseph Smeetslaan 280 in Maasmechelen ... well-marked hiking routes ... from approximately 3 to nearly 13 kilometers ... red triangle walk of 7.3 km, with pleasant elevation changes and a spectacular panorama point ... In August and September the heather blooms in 50 beautiful shades of purple.

claim: Thermae 2000 Valkenburg is around 28 km / 18 minutes by car from Maasmechelen, putting it roughly 40-45 km from Slagmolen in Opglabbeek - outside the 30 km radius but within easy day-trip reach.
quote: The distance from Maasmechelen to Valkenburg is 28 kilometers via road (including 24 kilometers via highways), and the route takes approximately 18 minutes.

claim: Opglabbeek (Slagmolen) sits about 15.5 km / 18 minutes by car from Maasmechelen, putting Elaisa/Terhills and the Mechelse Heide gateway comfortably within the 30 km radius.
quote: The driving distance between Maasmechelen and Opglabbeek is 15.5 km (9.6 miles), with a driving time of about 18 minutes.
